capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: ArenaEV lists the 92 kWh Air pack (matches Touring, sheet 2024/2025 and Evercars 2026) as 92 total / 89.6 usable; conflict: EV Database lists 92.0 usable (MY23-24) and 96.0 (MY25).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: same 2170 NMC cell family; Lucid battery data lists the MY26+ packs as "Li MM(NRMC)"; no pre-2026 page names the chemistry.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: Lucid 2025 Touring sheet platform architecture 700V+ (above 600 V, the 800 V class); Evercars says every Air is 900V-class.

preconditioning.notes: Lucid: manual Start Preconditioning plus Smart Preconditioning (automatic when routing to a fast charger). Current software state; the page is not year-specific.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: Estimated: 92 kWh in 2025 (Lucid sheet) and 2026 (Evercars); 2023 assumed unchanged. Lucid 2025 Touring sheet: battery capacity 92 kWh (18 module); 2024 sheet 92 (US), 91 (metric).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 2025 hardware; Electrek 2026: charging peak remains 250 kW. Lucid 2025 Touring sheet: DC up to 250 kW; 2024 sheet the same.

ac_max_kw.notes: Lucid Canada charging page: AC charging maximum 19.2 kW; Wikipedia lists 19.2 kW (240 V, 80 A) for every trim.
